_comment: Task plane executors. Copy to /srv/kamimusuhi/config/agent-executors.json (task_plane.executors_file). The resident re-reads this file when it changes: add, remove or disable (enabled:false) a harness without restarting. adapter = devin_cli | opencode | command_code | generic (generic needs command/run/permission_args; see docs/implementation/task-plane.md). Billing is per model: rules first, then a price the harness lists (>0 = metered), else default_billing (unknown unless declared). Only local/free_tier/subscription/included_credit are picked automatically; metered needs allow_metered and an explicit request. protocol: cli (process per task) | acp (long-lived Agent Client Protocol server; needed to continue Devin sessions). serve: true keeps `opencode serve` running and attaches runs to it. quota: max_tasks_per_day/month, max_usd_per_day/month, max_tokens_per_day (metered models need a usd limit).

executors.name: opencode
executors.description: OpenCode（repo 探索・調査・レビュー向け）

executors.description: Command Code（コード編集・デバッグ向け、プラン内クレジット）
